title: AI-Assisted Decision Support for Formula 1 Pit-Stop Strategy: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Mathematical Programming
abstract: arXiv:2611.26909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pit-stop strategy in Formula 1 is a sequential decision problem under uncertainty, in which strategists decide at each lap whether to pit and which tire compound to fit. We develop a data-driven simulator, calibrated with historical race data, that captures tire degradation, drivers' recent performance, overtaking, yellow flag events, and rivals' pit-stop decisions. We train agents with five Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithms and compare them with a Quadratic Mixed-Integer Programming (QMIP) formulation that is optimal in deterministic single-driver settings. Without uncertainty or competition, all DRL methods except TRPO achieve near-optimal performance. With a full grid of competitors and stochastic race events, the ranking of DRL methods depends on the evaluation setting: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and its recurrent variant are the only methods that improve on the QMIP both in fully simulated races and when the act

translated_title: AI辅助的F1进站策略决策支持：深度强化学习与数学规划
translated_abstract: F1比赛中的进站策略是一个不确定性下的序贯决策问题，策略师需要在每一圈决定是否进站以及更换哪种轮胎配方。我们开发了一个数据驱动的模拟器，该模拟器使用历史比赛数据进行校准，能够捕捉轮胎磨损、车手近期表现、超车、黄旗事件以及对手的进站决策。我们使用五种深度强化学习（DRL）算法训练智能体，并将其与二次混合整数规划（QMIP）模型进行对比，后者在确定性单车手设置下是最优的。在没有不确定性和竞争的情况下，除TRPO外，所有DRL方法均能达到接近最优的表现。在完整参赛阵容和随机比赛事件的条件下，DRL方法的排名取决于评估设置：近端策略优化（PPO）及其循环变体是唯一在完全模拟比赛以及实际场景中均能优于QMIP的方法。
tldr: 该研究构建了基于历史比赛数据校准的F1进站策略模拟器，用五种深度强化学习算法训练策略智能体并与QMIP数学规划模型对比，发现PPO及其循环变体是在真实比赛不确定性和竞争环境下唯一能超越确定性最优规划基线的DRL方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a data-calibrated F1 race simulator and trains pit-stop strategy agents with five DRL algorithms compared against a QMIP formulation, finding that PPO and its recurrent variant are the only methods that outperform the deterministic optimal baseline under full race uncertainty and competition.
